LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: NEATNESS AND LEGIBILITY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (2 Sessions) • Vocabulary building • Sentences By the
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (2 Sessions) • Vocabulary building • Sentences By the in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: Why is it good to write clearly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to discuss features of a neat and legible handwriting,

2. identify words used to describe members of the family and proffessions,

3. write the descriptive words on a chart for display,

4. use the descriptive words to write a paragraph neatly and legibly,

5. share their written work with peers for assessment,

6. put together a collection of neatly written work,

7. collaborate with peers to organise their neat and legible work in a class portfolio.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to discuss features of a neat and legible handwriting,
2. identify words used to describe members of the family and proffessions,
3. write the descriptive words on a chart for display,
4. use the descriptive words to write a paragraph neatly and legibly,
5. share their written work with peers for assessment,
6. put together a collection of neatly written work,
7. collaborate with peers to organise their neat and legible work in a class portfolio.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: These are promoted as the learner shares new ideas that inspire creativity when writing a

paragraph neatly and legibly.

• Self-efficacy: This is promoted as the learner shows concerted attention when working with peers to discuss features of a

neat and legible handwriting.

41

Values:
Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner diligently takes up assigned roles to organise their neat and legible work in a

class portfolio.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as the learner works with others to peer assess their work on ensuring neat and legible

handwriting for effective communication.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of neat and legible handwriting to the concept of neatness and legibility in English and

Kiswahili.
